name: wechat-mp/v2/comment-replies
description: Returns second-level replies under a specific WeChat MP article comment using the article url and comment identifiers. Supports pagination offset and raw output formats.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional, default True. True=full raw reply objects; False=simplified replies.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Optional, default 0 (>=0). Reply pagination offset; 0 for the first page, pass `next_offset` from the previous response when `has_more=true`. Ignored when `all_pages=true`.

comment_id.title: Comment Id
comment_id.description: 文章的评论 id（可选，**性能捷径**）：不传时上游要先抓并解析整篇文章 HTML 才能拿到它，约占本接口耗时的一半；已有该值时传进来可显著加快。取自 /fetch_article_detail 或 /fetch_article_detail_h5 响应的 `$.data.content.comment_id`/Article comment id (optional, performance shortcut): when omitted, upstream must fetch and parse the whole article HTML to obtain it, which accounts for about half of this endpoint's latency

content_id.title: Content Id
content_id.description: Optional (numeric). `content_id` of the target first-level comment, from `$.data.comments[N].content_id` of the `fetch_article_comments` response; **defaults to the first comment that has replies when omitted**. E.g. `12109128638545265979`

readme:
# WeChat MP Comment Replies API

Fetch second-level comment replies for a WeChat MP article by providing the article `url`. Specify `content_id` to target a specific comment thread.

## Use cases

- Retrieve nested reply threads under top-level article comments.
- Paginate through reader responses on popular WeChat MP posts.
- Speed up reply retrieval by supplying a pre-fetched comment_id.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-mp/v2/comment-replies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "<url>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Yes | WeChat MP article URL (`https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/…`). |
| `raw` | boolean | No | Optional, default True. |
| `offset` | integer | No | Optional, default 0 (>=0). |
| `comment_id` | string | No | 文章的评论 id（可选，性能捷径）：不传时上游要先抓并解析整篇文章 HTML 才能拿到它，约占本接口耗时的一半；已有该值时传进来可显著加快。取自 /fetch_article_detail 或 /fetch_article_detail_h5 响应的 `$.data.content.comment_id`/Artic… |
| `content_id` | string | No | Optional (numeric). |

## Notes

- Pass `comment_id` from article detail responses to avoid upstream HTML parsing and improve response latency.
- Target a specific comment thread by passing `content_id` obtained from comment listing endpoints; defaults to the first comment with replies when omitted.
- Page through replies by passing `next_offset` into `offset` when more results are available.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
